messages:
OpsBot: [incident bot] ALERT: metering ingestion discrepancy detected for prod (count delta > 5% window). Pager sent to #incidents.
Billing Bot: Automated overage flag emitted for 3 customers: cust-187, cust-42, cust-910.
Kiran Patel: I'm on it. Looking at ingest pipeline metrics now — beginning with kafka consumer lag and token-aggregation service.
Alex Chen: I see a step-change in quantized counter output from the token-aggregator around 02:12 UTC. Querying raw events...
Alex Chen: Query used: ```SELECT count(*) FROM tokens WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY shard;``` (truncated)
Jess Ortiz: Any customer-visible alerts? Support page shows two emails about overage flags; not yet widespread.
Kiran Patel: Consumer lag is low. Aggregator is emitting lower per-batch counts after a recent runtime change to quantize counters (PR #4421) — suspect rounding logic.
SRE Oncall: Suggest rollback of quantization flag to previous behavior for live mitigation. Can we patch quickly?
Alex Chen: Rolling a canary revert now to one instance group (canary-agg-us-east). Pushing a hotfix to set ENV QUANTIZE_BUCKET=off.
OpsBot: Deploy triggered by Alex Chen — deployment id deploy_20260317_0218. Watch for metric reversion.
Billing Bot: Note: overage flags are sticky; we'll need to suppress until counts reconcile. Propose marking flags as 'investigating' to avoid customer billing actions.
Jess Ortiz: I'll coordinate with support. Draft message: "We're investigating inaccurate usage alerts for a subset of customers; no billing actions taken yet." Shall I send?
Kiran Patel: Yes. Also kick a downstream backfill: run aggregator backfill for last 4 hours once canary shows restored counts. Backfill command: ```python backfill.py --start 2026-03-17T02:00Z --end 2026-03-17T06:00Z --scope=prod```
SRE Oncall: Canary metrics looking good — per-shard counts match pre-change within 0.5%. Promote revert to full cluster.
OpsBot: Deployment deploy_20260317_0225 completed across aggregator group.
Billing Bot: Detected reconciliation: flags cleared for cust-42 and cust-910; cust-187 still pending (manual inspect).
Alex Chen: Starting backfill job now, monitoring memory usage. ETA ~12m.
Jess Ortiz: Sent support message to affected customers. Copy: "We're investigating a reporting issue that caused transient overage alerts. No charges will be applied while we complete reconciliation." :white_check_mark: 
Kiran Patel: Backfill finished. Counts aligned. Manual check on cust-187 found a late-emitted batch — clearing flag.
Billing Bot: All overage flags cleared, billing state consistent with usage ledger at 02:00-06:00 window. Confirming postmortem tracking.
SRE Oncall: Leaving follow-up: PR #4421 review, add unit tests around quantization boundaries, add canary metric threshold to detect >1% drift.
Jess Ortiz: Opening customer incident note and NRR template. I'll loop PM and CS.
Kiran Patel: Closing pager — root cause: quantization arithmetic change in token-aggregator that caused undercounts leading to reconciliation-induced overage flags. Mitigation: rollback + backfill. Actions: code fix, tests, monitoring rules.
OpsBot: Incident closed by Kiran Patel at 02:35 UTC. Incident ID INC-20260317-084."
